statement: The doc's requested sections say what is true now, and nothing else in it changed.

deliverables.where: the document the request names, in the run's branch

final.text: Every section the request names is rewritten and no other section changed
final.check_method: Compare the document before and after with the request

scale.met: each named section is rewritten and every other section is byte-for-byte the same
scale.partial: no partial: any gap is UNMET
scale.unmet: a named section is unchanged, or a section the request did not name changed
scale.evidence: each named section and the diff of the others

outline.statement: outline.md lists every heading of the document, in order

criteria.text: outline.md exists and lists at least one heading
criteria.check_method: Read outline.md and count its lines that start with `#`

draft.statement: The rewrite keeps every heading of the outline and says what is true now

criteria.text: Every heading in outline.md is still in the document, in the same order
criteria.check_method: Read outline.md and the document and compare their headings

criteria.text: Every statement in each rewritten section matches the repository as it is now
criteria.check_method: Read each rewritten statement and the file or command it is about

scale.met: every statement holds against the repository
scale.partial: no partial: one false statement is UNMET
scale.evidence: each statement and the file that confirms or refutes it

review.statement: A review that names each rewritten section and says whether it is ready

criteria.text: The review names each rewritten section and gives `approve` or `redo` with a reason
criteria.check_method: Read the review's value and its reasons

scale.met: each rewritten section is named with a reason
scale.partial: no partial: a missing section is UNMET
scale.unmet: a rewritten section is not named, or a verdict has no reason
scale.evidence: the sections named and the reasons

criteria.text: A person approves the rewrite of each named section before the run ends

verifier.question: Is each rewritten section ready to keep?
